messages.author: 2dc12cba003ddf6e
messages.subject: Running different R sessions through Shiny
parts:
Hello,

Suppose I have 2 shiny projects and I want them to share some R code. This R code has DEV/PROD version so I can't really share through .Rprofile.  
The most ideal way will be to pass in a -DEV or -PROD param when I start Shiny so I can load different versions of R sessions on the same machine.
I am wondering if this is possible or there is a better way to do this.  

Thank you!

Mike
